description:
Senior Software Engineer | Data Platform Team

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!

We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to our Data Platform team in Brazil (Remote) !

The Data Platform Team is responsible for building and maintaining system components that pave the way for data engineers and analysts to deliver their business objectives. This team leverages open-source software, uses cloud infrastructure and services, and builds software to accomplish its mission.

People on this team have different technical backgrounds, such as software engineering, systems administration (Kubernetes), cloud infrastructure and services, data analysis, and data governance.

This is an established team with a strong culture that expects collaboration, humbleness, accountability, empathy, and a sense of humor.

Some ongoing and future projects

  • Migrate existing data lake tables to Apache Iceberg
  • Autoscale Trino for data transformation pipelines
  • Creating a GitHub App to manage table schemas with data contracts (GitOps + DataOps)
  • Optimize data lake tables for existing queries with statistics collection and file rewrites

YOUR IMPACT

  • Advocate for improvements in software quality, security, and performance
  • Embrace the DataOps mindset to streamline and optimize repetitive tasks
  • Collaborate with Analytics Engineers and Data Analysts to drive efficiencies for their work
  • Provide tooling that improves the product development process and prevents failures
  • Ensure that knowledge is shared effectively with internal documentation and personal interaction
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • BS degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience
  • Solid experience with Python, Java, or similar
  • Solid understanding of relational databases fundamentals and solid SQL skills (PostgreSQL preferred)
  • Familiarity with Kafka, Pulsar, or RabbitMQ (Kafka preferred)
  • Proficiency with Terraform, Pulumi, or Crossplane (Kubernetes experience desired)
  • Experience with distributed systems and data-intensive applications
  • Knowledge of analytical data warehouses
  • Genuine interest in big data applications and their technology trends

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don\'t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We\'re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

  • WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.
  • WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.
  • PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.
  • CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world. You\'ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of Life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

title: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER NODE
description:
Overview

O Ton é uma empresa do grupo Stone Co., focada em empoderar empreendedores autônomos por meio de soluções financeiras como maquininhas, conta digital, cartão e programa de renda extra. Nosso time é apaixonado por desafios e movido por impacto real na vida dos nossos clientes — sempre com leveza, autonomia e muita colaboração. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com um time de apaixonados por desafios, sempre preocupado em atender da melhor forma os nossos clientes e buscando as melhores escolhas técnicas para entregar os resultados. E mais importante, tudo isso em um ambiente descontraído com horário flexível e a possibilidade de trabalhar remoto.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

A equipe do programa Renda Extra | TON está dedicada a transformar vidas por meio de oportunidades únicas de geração de renda. Nosso programa oferece uma maneira inovadora para os nossos parceiros, de obter uma renda adicional ou até mesmo substituir sua fonte de renda principal sem nenhum vínculo empregatício. Nosso objetivo é empoderar as pessoas, proporcionando-lhes os meios para alcançar a estabilidade financeira e crescimento pessoal.

Senior Software Engineer Node

Você terá um papel essencial na evolução do nosso ecossistema, atuando no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, provas de conceito e melhorias contínuas nos nossos microsserviços e aplicações. Esperamos que você contribua ativamente desde a ideação até a entrega, participando de cerimônias, revisando código, mantendo e atualizando a documentação técnica. Fará parte de um time colaborativo, engajado em criar soluções escaláveis e de alto impacto, sempre em alinhamento com os padrões técnicos da companhia. Aqui, valorizamos opiniões, ideias novas e iniciativas — queremos que você protagonize melhorias e ajude a elevar a barra técnica do produto. Também é esperado que você compartilhe conhecimento com o time, lidere refatorações quando necessário, e participe ativamente do refinamento de demandas junto ao time de UX, garantindo entregas com qualidade e foco no cliente.

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência com NodeJS, TypeScript e Jest
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura moderna: SOLID, Clean Architecture, FaaS, APIs REST/WebSocket
  • Prática com AWS (Lambda, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, S3 etc.) e banco NoSQL (DynamoDB)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de cache e busca (Redis, OpenSearch/ElasticSearch)
  • Git, CI/CD, documentação técnica e segurança em desenvolvimento

O que aumenta as suas chances

  • Experiência Banco de Dados relacional
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de infraestrutura em código, como Terraform
  • Habilidade de otimização para suporte de alto volume de dados
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como DataDog, CloudWatch e Splunk
  • Experiência com automação de Testes e testes de carga (Jest, K6, JMeter)

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: com equipe médica 24/7
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação
  • Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (para vagas remotas)
  • Horário flexível
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com livros, podcasts, treinamentos e videoaulas
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  1. Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve.
  2. Entrevistas com o time de People: papo para conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio proposto.
  3. Avaliação Técnica: aprofundar hard skills com possibility de dois papos ou um desafio.
  4. Check de Cultura: conversa com guardiões da cultura para alinhar crenças e visão.
  5. Feedback: compartilharemos o feedback independente do resultado.
  6. E aí? Curtiu? Inscreva-se e #VemSerStone

ENGINE ROOM SUPERVISOR
Reports To: Maintenance Superintendent
Background: The Engine Room Supervisor will exhibit good leadership, supervisory and safety behaviours and will specifically ensure that all aspects of Engine Room operation and maintenance are carried out safely, through careful delegation and control of responsibilities.
Authority: The Engine Room Supervisor is specifically responsible for the operation and maintenance of Engine Room equipment and systems and also the competence of those under his immediate supervision.
Immediate Subordinates: Assistant Maintenance Supervisor, all ER personnel, visitors, vendor technicians, and subcontractors.
Typical Responsibilities & Standards

  • Engine Room Equipment and Systems and Utilities Operation and Maintenance:

1 Prepare Engine Room Plant and Systems for start-up, including vessel utility systems sourced from ER.
2 Start and Monitor Engine Room Plant and Systems, including vessel utility systems sourced from ER.
3 Prepare and Shutdown Engine Room Plant and Systems, including vessel utility systems sourced from ER.
4 Isolate and reinstate Engine Room Plant and for Maintenance, including vessel utility systems sourced from ER.

  • Manage And Supervise Effectively:

1 Establish effective relationships with colleagues and subordinates.
2 Establish scope of work clearly (briefings, toolbox talks, presentations.)
3 Plan and control use of resources effectively. (Personnel, time, materials, transport, IT).
4 Use of communication skills shows leadership (oral, teambuilding, recording, noting, handover, analysing.
5 Objective and consistent in assessment of subordinates using competence assessment system.
6 Make recommendations and improvements in working practices for greater safety, efficiency and profitability.
7 Ensure all Maintenance (Routine and breakdown) is completed and recorded accurately and clearly
8 Ensure all plant and machinery complies with Class and Inspections

  • Contribute To Control Of Critical Situations And Respond To Emergencies:

1 Developing critical situations (operational, weather, equipment failure, leaks, fires personnel etc) are identified and logged for later analysis
2 Positive action is taken to limit escalation and to maintain control using applied policies or procedures or initiative
3 External agencies as appropriate are alerted in good time.

  • Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures:

1 Sample and check that controlled discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits
2 Identify and halt unplanned discharges where possible, and reported immediately according to policy, procedure and regulation.
3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure
4 Resources such as PPE materials tools and spares are not wasted or used inefficiently

  • Emergency Response:

1 Show competence during drills and exercises.
2 Carry Out Emergency Response Role
Qualifications And Experience

  • STCW Reg.III/2 Chief Engineer Unlimited Certificate (Steam and Motor endorsement preferred), (DCE for Petroleum/Gas as appropriate)
  • Experience as Chief Engineer on VLCC preferred and at least 2 yrs as 1st Engineer.
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing and utility systems desirable.
  • Computer literate in Management System ‘Office’ software packages and experienced on maintenance management systems. Experience in Permit to Work Systems.
  • Medically fit to offshore International standards such as ENG1 or equivalent.

Additional

A General Manager is responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience while managing profitability and guest satisfaction measures.


What will I be doing?

As a General Manager, you are responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience. A General Manager will also be required to manage profitability and guest satisfaction measures. Specifically, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Manage ongoing profitability of your hotel, ensuring revenue and guest satisfaction targets are met and exceeded
  • Lead in all key property issues including capital projects, customer service, and refurbishment
  • Ensure all decisions are made in the best interest of the hotels and Hilton
  • Deliver achievable hotel budgets, and set other short- and long- term strategic goals for the property
  • Provide effective leadership to hotel team members
  • Lead in all aspects of business planning
  • Comply with and exceed Hilton Brand Service Standards
  • Ensure costs are controlled and revenue opportunities are effectively sourced and delivered
  • Manage and develop the Hotel Executive team to ensure career progression and effective succession planning within Hilton
  • Hold regular briefings and communication meetings with the HOD team
  • Respond to audits to ensure continual improvement is achieved

What are we looking for?

A General Manager serving Hilton brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Experience as General Manager or Director of Operations within a similar quality hotel
  • Degree or diploma in Hotel Management or equivalent
  • Possesss strong commercial acumen, with experience in increasing profitability
  • Experience managing budgets, revenue proposals, and forecasting results in a similar sized property
  • Excellent leadership skills
  • Exceptional communication skills
  • In-depth knowledge of the hotel/leisure/service sector

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • General Management experience in a similar quality hotel

What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travelers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands . Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar!

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura.

O que você vai fazer

  • Ter a oportunidade de ajudar a transformar em unicórnio uma empresa com um dos maiores potenciais do mercado brasileiro;
  • Ajudar na remodelagem do ambiente analítico da empresa, sendo referência no uso de dados e traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas robustas;
  • Aumentar a confiabilidade dos insights baseados em dados com boas práticas de modelagem de dados em produtos de dados fundacionais e derivados;

  • Profunda mentalidade de ownership, demonstrando forte responsabilidade pelo que constrói e mantém;

  • Colaborativo e responsável, ajudando de forma proativa seus colegas sem prejudicar seus próprios compromissos;

  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade para colaborar em um ambiente de constante dinamismo. Somos uma startup e tomadas de decisão rápidas e assertivas fazem parte da nossa essência.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • SQL avançado (otimização, CTEs, window functions);
  • Fluência em metodologias de modelagem analítica de dados (Data Vault, Kimball, Star Schema etc.);

title: Commissioned Sales Representative - LATAM Region (Remote)
description:
About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

Ownership: We take responsibility for our actions.

At Pacifica, you will have ample opportunities to grow and contribute to the development of others. We prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Take a Look Into Your Future at Pacifica Continental

As a Data Specialist , you will develop projects within Pacifica’s data and process technology scope, aiming to optimize business performance, facilitate management, and reduce costs.

This role includes managing data architecture, overseeing Azure, MS Fabric, and Power Platform infrastructure, fostering innovation, managing internal ERP (PacOS) and CRMs (JazzHR, Apollo, Zoho, Hubspot, DashR...), addressing stakeholder requests, developing dashboards, automations, ETL processes, and maintaining cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with Azure services including SQL, Virtual Machines, Web Apps, IAM, Entra, Docker;
  • Proficiency with Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint, Postman, API Requests, N8N;
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric or similar platforms;
  • Knowledge of CRM systems like Hubspot, Apollo, JazzHR, Zoho is advantageous.

title: E tech lead
description:
Sobre nós

Somos uma startup recifense focada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais inovadoras que geram impacto real no setor público. Atuamos em áreas essenciais como saúde, educação e justiça, sempre com o propósito de transformar serviços públicos por meio da tecnologia. Procuramos profissionais que entendam a importância do sucesso dos nossos clientes públicos, tenham compromisso com a geração de valor e saibam atuar em contextos desafiadores e estratégicos. Se você quer fazer parte de uma operação em plena expansão e contribuir com uma equipe estruturada e orientada a resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe. Seu papel será liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento do nosso produto de gerenciamento de atendimento (Service Management), construído sobre nossa plataforma low-code. O desafio é guiar o time na criação de uma solução robusta e escalável, promovendo inovação e excelência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir o alinhamento técnico entre times e especialistas, assegurando coesão arquitetural e boas práticas.
  • Avaliar e apoiar decisões técnicas em frontend (Vue.js), backend (Node.js, Express), banco de dados (MySQL) e cloud (GCP), em conjunto com especialistas de cada área.
  • Definir e documentar diretrizes arquiteturais, priorizando escalabilidade, eficiência e segurança.
  • Mentorar o time de desenvolvimento, incentivando boas práticas e a troca de conhecimento entre áreas.
  • Atuar como ponte entre desenvolvimento, produto e design, alinhando soluções técnicas aos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Planejar, delegar e acompanhar atividades, equilibrando prazos e qualidade.

Principais desafios

  • Evoluir nosso UI Builder: Participar da evolução do construtor de componentes e páginas, que permite criar telas e fluxos completos utilizando recursos do Vue.js por meio de interface, com alguns cliques e poucas linhas de código. Nosso objetivo é trazer a experiência de codar para o UI Builder, permitindo que até páginas mais complexas possam ser construídas nele.
  • Desenvolver nossa solução white label: Contribuir para a evolução do motor de criação de plataformas white label, que oferece funcionalidades nativas como autenticação, gerenciamento de usuários, permissões, construtor de formulários, CRUD de tabelas SQL via interface, CSM, entre outras. Tudo isso em um ambiente isolado para cada cliente, com possibilidade de customizações específicas.
  • Aprimorar nosso marketplace de páginas: Criar e expandir o marketplace que permite a publicação, instalação e gestão de páginas desenvolvidas em Vue, compartilháveis entre diferentes clientes do nosso ecossistema.
  • Expandir nossa biblioteca de componentes: Desenvolver componentes únicos e reutilizáveis, como formulários dinâmicos, calendários, gráficos Gantt, listas com integração nativa a APIs etc.
  • Desenvolver soluções de IA e Machine Learning: Criar fluxos com LLMs, integrando funções acionáveis em contextos específicos (como consultas em banco de dados). Implementar RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) por meio de vetorização de dados, buscas por similaridade e integração com LLM.
  • Automatizar com fluxos low-code/no-code: Implementar soluções usando ferramentas como N8N e ActivePieces, construindo fluxos e APIs completas via interface. Também criar novos nós reutilizáveis por toda a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Contribuir para o open source: Apoiar a abertura dos nossos produtos para a comunidade, fomentando colaboração global e ampliando o impacto das soluções.

Informações adicionais

  • Contratação PJ.
  • Trabalho remoto, com encontros presenciais ocasionais em Recife (valorizamos esses momentos, mas não são uma exigência).
  • Horários flexíveis, com foco em resultados.

Por que trabalhar na Beyond?

  • Impacto positivo real: Nossos produtos transformam áreas como educação, saúde e direito.
  • Crescimento acelerado: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento por meio de cursos, workshops e eventos.
  • Equipe de alto nível: Ambiente colaborativo, com aprendizado constante.
  • Cultura inclusiva: Valorizamos diversidade, bem-estar e crescimento profissional.

Benefícios e bem-estar

  • Check in premiado: Cada ida ao escritório gera um número da sorte para concorrer a prêmios semanais, mensais e anuais.
  • Aulas de Inglês gratuitas ministradas por professores qualificados até 2x na semana.

Strategy & Operations Senior Analyst (Performance)

Rio de Janeiro - Brazil

About the company

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don\'t even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

We are looking for talented professionals to join our Regional Operations team at 99Food ! This is an exciting opportunity for individuals who are highly analytical, data-driven, and eager to solve complex business challenges at the city level. If you have a start-up spirit and are always looking to create value, you would be a great fit for this team!

As part of Regional Operations , selected candidates will play a key role in driving city growth, improving marketplace performance, and shaping local strategies that connect users, restaurants, and couriers. This role requires a hands-on approach, strong problem-solving skills, and a proactive mindset to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency, and differentiation.

The ideal candidates will engage directly with restaurant partners, customers, and business development teams to understand the dynamics of each city. They will analyze local performance data, gather on-the-ground perspectives, and translate insights into actionable strategies that strengthen 99Food’s position in each market and ensure long-term sustainable growth.

In this role, you\'ll be...

As a Strategy & Operations Senior Analyst at 99Food, you will be responsible for monitoring and analyzing the performance of our marketplace, growth campaigns, and communication initiatives . Your role is critical in ensuring that strategies are not only well-designed but also effectively executed and continuously optimized.

You will take ownership of building and maintaining performance dashboards, identifying key trends, and uncovering improvement opportunities across cities. By translating data into actionable insights, you will support decision-making and help guide campaign strategy, restaurant engagement, and customer growth.

This position requires a professional who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and structured , with strong communication skills to collaborate across Operations, Marketing, CRM, Product, and BD teams. You will act as the bridge between strategy and execution , ensuring that every initiative is measured, tracked, and improved to maximize its impact.

Your work will directly contribute to shaping how 99Food grows and strengthens its position in competitive markets, driving both short-term results and long-term expansion .

We\'re eager to be in touch because you have...

  • General Requirements
    • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Business Administration, Economics, or related fields.
    • 2–5 years of experience in data analytics, operations, strategy, or growth-related roles.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
    • Advanced Excel, SQL, and data analytics skills (Python/R knowledge is a plus, but not required).
  • Performance Management
    • Experience with campaign results analysis, including performance tracking, communication effectiveness, and financial tracking.
    • Prior experience with customer-related activities (e.g., campaign management, communication strategy, customer cohort analysis, market analysis, budget management, etc.).
    • Stakeholder and project management experience, with exposure to Operations, Product, Sales/BD, and Marketing/CRM.
    • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Mandarin is a strong plus.

You\'ll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value. We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and more than 1800 employees in 50+ countries. Docusign brings agreements to life. Overview

When you think of InComm Payments, think of Innovative Payments Technology. We were founded over 30 years ago and continue to be a pioneer in the payment (FinTech) industry. Since our inception, we have grown to be a team of over 3,000 employees in 35 countries around the world. We are significantly growing our Engineering and IT teams in Brazil and are focused on finding talent for various financial technology (Fintech) engineering, database, development, and testing teams.

InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future. Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses! All positions are CLT.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn , YouTube , Twitter , Facebook , or Instagram .


About This Opportunity

Join our lean and dynamic NOC team as a NOC Technician, where you will play a key role in maintaining the operational excellence of our network. This position is ideal for someone with a basic understanding of networking concepts and a strong willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, 24/7/365 environment. As part of our team, you will be responsible for monitoring alerts, managing emails and tickets, and escalating issues to ensure continuous network performance.
Given the lean nature of our NOC, flexibility is crucial. While your primary schedule will be 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, you must be open to shift changes and occasional late-night deployments to support live monitoring of our network resources during those deployments.


Responsibilities
  • Monitor network alerts using tools such as Solar Winds, Thousand Eyes, Pingdom, or Splunk.
  • Respond to emails and manage tickets in ServiceNow ITSM.
  • Escalate issues to more experienced team members when necessary.
  • Participate in shift changes and late-night deployments as needed.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure continuous network operations and quick resolution of incidents.

Qualifications
  • 1–2 years of experience in a networking or IT support role.
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, VPN, routing).
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools and ticket management systems (ServiceNow experience is a plus).
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends as needed.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.
  • Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration and knowledge sharing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experi- ence preferred.
  • CCNA or other entry-level networking certifications are a plus.
  • Experience with AVI and F5 load balancers.
  • Familiarity with Cisco and Palo Alto network devices.
  • Knowledge of Itential automation tools and Ansible.
  • Experience with network monitoring tools such as Solar Winds, Thousand Eyes, Pingdom, or Splunk.

Overview

O que buscamos

Procuramos Scrum Master Pleno para facilitar e liderar a execução de sprints, focando na entrega constante de valor através de uma excelente gestão dos processos ágeis. Unimos design e tecnologia para resolver problemas complexos de empresas.

Banco de Talentos

Não encontrou uma vaga para você? Cadastre seu currículo aqui e venha fazer parte do nosso Banco de Talentos !

O Banco de Talentos tem o objetivo de criar uma base de candidatos pré-selecionados para oportunidades de emprego futuras. Ao se inscrever nessa vaga, você terá a chance de trabalhar na maior marca de futebol e clube poliesportivo da América Latina!

A inscrição em nosso Banco de Talentos não garante a contratação, pois ela dependerá da disponibilidade de vagas e compatibilidade do currículo com os requisitos de cada oportunidade.

Falando sobre o Flamengo...

Que tal trabalhar em um clube de futebol referência em gestão?

Após um árduo trabalho de reestruturação, o Clube de Regatas do Flamengo tornou-se uma das marcas de maior credibilidade no cenário nacional, atraindo grandes parceiros comerciais e investindo pesado em infraestrutura e recursos humanos. Aqui a gente procura os melhores craques para todas as modalidades - inclusive nos setores administrativos! Dos mais jovens talentos com sede de aprendizado aos profissionais mais gabaritados e experientes para gerir nossas equipes, aqui tem espaço para todos, de todas as cores, crenças e gêneros.

Venha ser um dos craques do maior clube poliesportivo do Brasil!

O Flamengo é a maior marca de futebol e o maior clube poliesportivo da América Latina. Conhecido por ter a Maior Torcida do Mundo, com mais de 48 milhões de rubro-negros apaixonados espalhados pelo mundo, foi fundado em 1895 e, desde então, coleciona títulos em diversas modalidades esportivas ao longo de sua história centenária. No futebol, carro-chefe do clube, o Flamengo é octacampeão brasileiro, pentacampeão da Copa do Brasil, maior vencedor do Campeonato Carioca com 39 títulos, tricampeão da Copa Libertadores e campeão mundial de clubes, taças erguidas por grandes craques do futebol que vestiram o Manto Sagrado e, é claro, pela Nação Rubro-Negra, sempre atuante como 12º jogador.

O clube colheu os frutos e os números se transformaram em resultado esportivo, com troféus erguidos pelo futebol e pelos esportes olímpicos, conquistando campeonatos nacionais de remo, basquete, ginástica artística, polo aquático, nado artístico e até mesmo esportes eletrônicos. Nos últimos Jogos Olímpicos, em Tóquio e Paris, o Mais Querido teve diversos representantes e fez bonito com as conquistas históricas das ginastas Rebeca Andrade, Jade Barbosa, Lorrane Oliveira e Flavia Saraiva, do canoísta Isaquias Queiroz e da judoca Rafaela Silva, todos atletas rubro-negros.

Já pensou em poder fazer parte de tudo isso?

Trabalhar no Flamengo é diferente de tudo que você já viveu…

Trabalhar com paixão é mágico e muito especial. Ser um colaborador do Flamengo é ver a história sendo escrita de perto, é ter a emoção como colega de trabalho, é sentir como é gratificante fazer parte de grandes conquistas, é fazer parte de uma família e de uma Nação. Job ID: | Amazon Servicos de Varejo do Brasil Ltda.

A ATS (Amazon Transportation Services) está procurando por pessoas motivadas para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial que entregue mercadorias no prazo e com o melhor custo. O objetivo da nossa equipe é gerenciar com excelência a execução do frete que flui através de nossas redes de transporte, focada especificamente no gerenciamento, desenvolvimento, qualidade e desempenho de transportadoras.
Esse papel exige por uma pessoa ambiciosa. Você representará uma função crítica em nossas operações de transporte mais amplas na Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos para melhorar continuamente os níveis de serviço, prezando pela segurança em nossas instalações. Isso nos ajudará a garantir que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas sempre.
Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento Sort Center/Carrier, garantindo que o caminhão saia do SC para entregar os pedidos dos clientes conforme a promessa. Essa pessoa também monitora a chegada da nossa frota e aborda quaisquer possíveis problemas que ocorram durante o ciclo de vida do frete saindo do FC/SC e chegando às instalações do cliente.
Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de solucionar o problema em tempo hábil pesquisando e consultando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões em tempo real. Você deve ser capaz de entender os requisitos/ser capaz de analisar dados e observar tendências e ser capaz de impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem comprometer o tempo. Ter o conhecimento básico de Logística e deve ser capaz de se comunicar claramente na forma escrita e oral, também é necessário. A pessoa deve ser capaz de idealizar melhorias no processo e ter o zelo de levá-las à conclusão.
Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não só celebramos a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, mas também as diversas formas de trabalhar. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para o processo de entrevista ou integração, informe nossa equipe e nós o conectaremos à nossa equipe de acomodação.
Essa função funcionará em turnos 3x2 das 18h às 5h
Key job responsibilities
Comunicação com clientes externos (transportadoras, fornecedores/fornecedores) e clientes internos (varejo, finanças, suporte de software, centros de atendimento, estações de entrega, centros de classificação).
Capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é uma vantagem.
Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho para ajudar a impulsionar os resultados comerciais.
Deve ser capaz de entender rapidamente o impacto comercial das tendências e tomar decisões que façam sentido com base nos dados disponíveis.
Deve ser capaz de encaminhar sistematicamente problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes e cumprir as resoluções para garantir que sejam entregues.
Trabalhe dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, ao mesmo tempo em que mede e identifica as atividades realizadas.
Excelente comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita, para criar uma narrativa descrevendo as descobertas semanais e as variações das metas, e apresentá-las em um fórum de revisão.
Suporta o monitoramento da chegada de veículos, correta alocação de veículos no horário necessário para carregamento, nas docas corretas, respeitando todos os padrões de segurança Amazon.
Responder às atividades de agendamento de veículos.
Prioriza-define a alocação dos veículos em doca.
A day in the life
O Ops Lead é o principal ponto de contato de transportes dentro de um centro de distribuição/ sort center. Ele(a) será o guardião de segurança e qualidade em todas as movimentações de Inbound e Outbound dentro das instalações Amazon. Garantirá a execução da rotina e a exelência nos resultados das métricas. Analisará qualquer desvio, mesmo que pequeno, para evitar problemas de qualidade e segurança. Escalará pontenciais riscos de atendimento para a liderança, e garantirá o fluxo de entrada e saída de veículos sem gargalos.

Experiência com Excel

At Dadosfera, we’re building a robust and scalable data platform that empowers organizations to make data-driven decisions with confidence.   • Ability to read technical documentation and write specs in English
  • Experience with SaaS product development (billing, subscriptions, multi-tenancy)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous role as a startup founder or CTO
  • Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK)
  • Experience in event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, pub/sub)
  • Knowledge of resilient microservice patterns (circuit breaker, retries)
  • Understanding of application security principles (OWASP, network policies, vulnerability scanning)
  • Contributions to open source projects
  • Exposure to data infrastructure tools such as Airflow or Spark, and/or experience with Data & AI platforms

Overview

Engineering Manager - Security Standards and Hardening at Canonical. The role leads security standards for open source software across the Ubuntu platform, including desktops, servers, edge devices, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and OpenStack. You will work on cryptographic modules (FIPS 140) and system hardening, partnering with CIS and DISA to define and build secure deployments. You will drive security excellence for millions of users and influence development teams and external partners.

Canonical is committed to delivering the world\'s best open source platform and upholding high standards for software security across the ecosystem. Ubuntu is a leading platform for large-scale cloud and edge deployments, and the role involves helping customers meet security requirements such as FIPS, CIS, STIG, FedRAMP and the CRA.

What you will do

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers across levels from graduate to senior
  • Coach, mentor, and provide career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise strong engineering and organizational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Support products and customers to meet strict product security requirements (FIPS, CIS, STIG, FedRAMP, CRA)
  • Contribute to cryptography modules (FIPS 140) and system hardening efforts with industry partners (CIS, DISA)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure secure deployments

What we are looking for

  • Strong academic track record from high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling alternative path
  • Driven with a track record of going above and beyond
  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English
  • Experience in developing people and growing teams
  • Organised with the ability to deliver timely, high-quality results
  • Professional interactions with colleagues, partners, and the community
  • Experience with FIPS/Common Criteria certified products and knowledge of underlying standards
  • Experience with DISA-STIG or CIS benchmarks and related audit/remediation tooling (e.g., Compliance as Code)
  • Strong interest in software and application security
  • Experience in an agile development environment
  • Demonstrated continuous learning mindset
  • Ability to build trust and relationships, and to drive results
  • Willingness to travel twice a year for company events (up to two weeks per trip)

Optional qualifications

  • Hands-on knowledge of Linux cryptography libraries (OpenSSL, GnuTLS) or similar domain experience

What we offer

Canonical offers compensation based on geography, experience, and performance, with annual reviews and a performance-driven bonus. We provide a comprehensive benefits package and support global fairness in compensation.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly in-person team sprints
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunities to travel to meet colleagues
  • Travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech company and the publisher of Ubuntu. We recruit globally and uphold high standards, with a remote-first approach since 2004. We value excellence and continuous learning. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

About The Job

Did you know that Hopper technology powers some of the largest travel portals in the world? Our Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) platform is the engine that drives travel purchases for major brands like Capital One, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Nubank, and many more!

HTS is growing fast, and we need your help to accelerate our journey even further!

We are looking for a Frontend Engineer who can do more than just build—someone who can help architect, optimize, and scale. In this role, you won’t just develop features; you’ll help define the foundations for scalable, high-performance travel portals.

You will work on a next-generation lodging, car, and packaging platform, helping top brands drive ancillary revenue while enabling Hopper to grow exponentially. We seek an experienced React engineer passionate about building world-class user experiences and reducing long-term maintenance overhead.

Our ideal candidate is not just a strong coder but a problem-solver—someone who can balance reusable white-label solutions with tailored customizations for our partners. You’ll have a seat at the table, working closely with product, design, and engineering peers to shape the architecture that powers multiple portals at scale.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Work with a group of top-tier engineers in a low-process environment powered by trust and autonomy.
  • Drive decisions and consensus asynchronously with thoughtful documentation.
  • Ship fast. Learn fast. Repeat. Build new features from top to bottom…from UX to database.
  • Architect scalable front-end solutions that allow us to efficiently launch new portals.
  • Work directly with PMs and business partners to help define and refine our roadmap. Your voice matters.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with a diverse group of people, giving and receiving feedback for growth.

An Ideal Candidate Has

  • Deep expertise in React (functional components, hooks, performance optimizations, server-side rendering, hydration, and advanced state management).
  • Extensive experience with complex state management (React Context, Redux, Zustand, or similar).
  • Advanced CSS knowledge (SCSS, CSS-in-JS, Tailwind, animations, and handling browser quirks).
  • Proficiency in TypeScript, with experience developing and maintaining enterprise-scale applications.
  • Experience optimizing frontend performance (lazy loading, code-splitting, caching strategies, Lighthouse optimizations, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of frontend architecture and how to design scalable, maintainable systems.
  • Familiarity with SSR and static site generation (e.g., Next.js) for SEO-friendly experiences.
  • Experience working with backend APIs (GraphQL, REST) and handling data-fetching strategies efficiently.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with backend systems and cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, etc.) is nice to have, but not mandatory.
  • A passion for writing testable code—knowing what to test, what not to test, and what kinds of tests matter in front-end applications.

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

description:

Base pay range

$60,000.00/yr - $70,000.00/yr

As a Sr. Product Data Analyst, you'll be directly impacting our results through insights and reports. You'll be working close to product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. It will be your responsibility, alongside the Analytics team, to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, be it through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, training.

Help Us Build the Future of Outdoor Services

At LawnStarter, we are transforming the $100B+ outdoor home services industry—making it easier for homeowners to book, manage, and enjoy services like lawn care, landscaping, and more. With $30M+ in venture funding and solid traction, we are investing in the next generation of our platform—and we are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to help drive it.

See what we are building!

Problems to be solved

Your primary responsibility will be to empower our organization to be more data-driven, with multiple avenues to accomplish that, such as:

  • Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system with various moving parts and often conflicting signals. This creates opportunities to identify gaps, insights, or optimizations. The analyses and models may range from simple AB tests to multivariate models on retention or ETA. You should have advanced experience in SQL and intermediate experience in Python or R.
  • Reporting: A complex system creates many metrics to track for running the business efficiently. You will work with teams to understand their needs and help the Analytics team create and maintain a reliable, user-friendly reporting system, primarily using Tableau and Metabase.
  • Analytics Engineering: Occasionally you will work on the inner layers of our Data Warehouse to provide clean and documented datasets for reports and end users. Understanding business needs and translating them into our DW is crucial; we use DBT for data transformation, so SQL experience is a must.

Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years in data & analytics at data-driven companies
  • Education: STEM or business background or relevant education that enables you to empower the organization to be more data-driven
  • Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply, asking the right questions, and approaching problems with structure and logic. You adapt to the business as needed rather than applying a fixed process blindly.
  • Team player: You collaborate effectively with others and create an environment where people are excited to work with you, with intellectual honesty and trust
  • Business focus: You understand how your analysis connects with product, customers, and financials, and can drill down metrics from top to bottom as needed
  • Bias for action: You balance careful analysis with getting things done, avoiding unnecessary perfectionism or rigid full-solution builds before validating with real use

VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER: Please upload your English resume—applications without it will not be considered.

Benefits

  • Salary range: $60-$70k USD annually
  • Work from anywhere
  • Flexible hours—complete work on your schedule
  • Unlimited PTO — Focus on results. Take time you need to recharge or work hard when you return

LawnStarter is building the future of outdoor home services. Want to help us shape it?
Apply now and let's grow together.

  • Skilled in Feedback: You are adept at giving and receiving feedback, understanding its role in personal and team growth.
  • Effective Remotely: You can work efficiently in a remote setting during an 8-hour day shift while ensuring overlap with our core hours (9 AM to 2 PM PT).
  • English Language Proficiency: Strong fluency in both written and spoken English is essential to ensure clear, effective communication across our global team.

While your core engineering mindset and approach are paramount, additional skills and experiences will be advantageous:

title: Mid-Level Software Engineer | BASE Team
description:
Overview

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company. Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub! We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Mid-level Software Engineer to join our BASE Focus Area (Tagus team) in Brazil! This is a Remote position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

At the Tagus team, we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a truly scalable platform to support dozens of millions of active users, clients, and partners around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models.

We have many important challenges such as building a system that gives us the flexibility to have different commercial conditions for different users in different contexts. Also, we are responsible for some critical and important flows within our business model, such as clients\' and users\' subscriptions as well as providing data to the ecosystem as the source of truth of these entities.

When it comes to technical challenges, our team works to provide highly scalable solutions, handling large volumes of data and focusing on high availability. Considering our services central role, you’re going to have the opportunity to help drive architecture decisions that impact our whole microservices ecosystem and you will have opportunities to develop both leadership and technical skills, depending on your career aspirations and abilities.

Your impact

  • Participate in the development of some of the most critical and challenging services in our ecosystem, seeking to build long-term and sustainable solutions.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain and improve services focusing on performance, scalability, and resilience;
  • Build integration with 3rd party API and tools;
  • Support existing systems looking to enhance functionality, increase scale, and transform in new ways to meet our product demands;
  • Work in a collaborative and agile environment that prioritizes people over process and is laser-focused on productivity;
  • Work with cutting-edge technologies and edge cases on a global scale.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

Who you are

  • An engineer with a bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent professional experience;
  • Experienced in architecting large-scale multi-tier web applications;
  • Experienced in designing and developing complex modern web applications;
  • Experienced in Cloud-based architectures (AWS / GCP);
  • Experienced in developing RESTful web services collaborating with front-end teams to create mocks, define payloads and follow the HTTP best practices;
  • Experienced in applying computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithm design, problem-solving, and complexity analysis;
  • Experienced in working with SQL/NoSQL technology such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB understanding common use cases and performance pitfalls
  • Proficient in one or more programming languages (Java/Ruby/Go/C++/etc.). Golang will be considered a plus;

description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 30 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

What You’ll Do

  • Owning major features and working closely with our design team - take ownership of features inside the app and become responsible of delivering high quality features
  • Shape the future of our Android team
  • Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Participate in discussions across different teams - Product, Design, Engineering
  • Review pull requests, and support other teammates
  • Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges
  • Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Familiarity with Android components
  • Experience building or contributing to at least one Android app
  • Product design intuition and user empathy
  • Drive to push the boundaries of Android UI/UX
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing tests
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase above and beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Rock solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android Animations, Jetpack Navigation, JUnit tests
  • Excellent communication skills
  • User oriented problem solving approach
  • Driven with continuous feedback from leaders

Bonus:

  • Experience building, maintaining, or otherwise contributing to open source projects in Android
  • Experience with iOS, Web or NodeJS

Technologies we use:

  • Kotlin
  • Kotlin Coroutines
  • Kotlin Flow
  • Jetpack Navigation
  • Dagger 2
  • Room
  • Custom Views, Canvas & Paint
  • Jetpack Compose
  • JUnit

What We offer

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
  • Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
  • Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.
  • Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.
  • Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

Planejar e organizar a rotina da cozinha, incluindo horários de produção e operação. Monitorar o tempo de produção e garantir que os prazos sejam cumpridos.

  • Experience with test frameworks like JUnit
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools: GitHub, Jenkins, ArgoCD
  • Basic understanding of Kubernetes and containerized apps (preferred)
  • Proven ability to define and maintain QA strategies, policies, and documentation
  • Proficient in IDEs like Eclipse and IntelliJ

O Promotor de Merchandising é na linha de frente com os nossos clientes representando a Coty e fazendo com que os nossos produtos estejam sempre disponíveis para os nossos consumidores.

Sobre a Coty

Fundada em Paris em 1904, a Coty é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do mundo. Com portfólio de marcas consagradas em fragrâncias, maquiagens e esmaltes, cuidados com pele e corpo, a empresa atende clientes em todo o mundo e está presente em cerca de 130 países. A Coty e as suas marcas estimulam o empoderamento das pessoas para que se expressem livresmente, criando suas próprias visões de beleza; além de serem comprometidas em fomentar positivo impacto no planeta.

No Brasil, o Grupo Coty conta com aproximadamente 2,4 mil funcionários alocados em suas empresas, localizadas no Estado de São Paulo (área de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento e sede administrativa); no Estado de Goiás (fábrica Savoy e o principal centro de distribuição); e no Estado do Rio de Janeiro (centro de distribuição).

Localmente, fabricamos e comercializamos milhões de produtos todos os anos, de nossas tradicionais marcas brasileiras - como Risqué, Monange, Bozzano, Paixão, Cenoura & Bronze e outras muito conhecidas pelos brasileiros. Além disso, também comercializamos nossas fragrâncias internacionais, licenciadas de famosas marcas (Calvin Klein, Lacoste, Hugo Boss, Chloé, Burberry, Gucci, Tiffany, entre outras); e produtos de maquiagem e skincare, com Kylie Cosmetics e Kylie Skin.

Na Coty, acreditamos que hoje ninguém pode controlar ou deve ditar o que é ou não bonito. Estamos em busca de uma nova era de beleza - uma em que, juntos, a cocriamos de maneira que você possa se expressar da forma que desejar. Como companhia dessa indústria, nosso propósito é viabilizar, conjuntamente, todas as visões de beleza.

O conceito de beleza não é fixo; é algo fluido, como a água – em constante evolução e adaptação. Não é singular, e sim plural. É hora de desconstruir todos os conceitos de beleza.

Tornamos ‘fearless kindness’ ( sem medo de ser gentil, gentileza destemida ) a base dos nossos valores, porque sabemos que agora, mais do que nunca, o mundo precisa de gentileza. É um atributo e uma ação que tem um efeito de ondulação que irradia muito - gentileza para consigo mesmo, gentileza para com os outros e gentileza para com o planeta.

Portanto, hoje e todos os dias, junte-se a nós para fazer da ‘fearless kindness’ a base para suas decisões e ações; juntos, vamos causar impacto positivo no nosso próprio bem-estar mental e daqueles que nos rodeiam.

Queremos PROFISSIONAIS DIVERSOS no nosso time!

Acreditamos que vivências diferentes tornam o time vencedor. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são para todos, independentemente de raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, idade, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, estado civil ou qualquer outra característica. Ou seja, valorizamos exatamente quem VOCÊ é!

Somos a marca líder em Requeijão no Brasil, com mais de 100 anos de tradição e inovação. Somos o requeijão #1 do Brasil, sabor que conecta! Só Catupiry é Catupiry! Você irá fazer parte de um Time que busca cada vez mais inovação, agilidade e desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar estratégias de vendas com base na análise do perfil e desempenho dos clientes/redes, alinhadas ao plano de crescimento regional.

  • Participar e conduzir processos seletivos da área, em alinhamento com as diretrizes organizacionais.

  • Planejar e acompanhar a programação anual de férias da equipe.

Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência no cargo e preferencialmente nos segmentos de alimentos, bebidas ou bens de consumo.
  • Desejável experiência anterior com grandes contas ou redes Varejistas de Autosserviço e Atacado.

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Sólido conhecimento em técnicas de vendas, negociação e gestão de canais
  • Domínio avançado de Microsoft Excel e habilidade em leitura e interpretação de relatórios gerenciais e dashboards de BI.
  • Conhecimento e experiência com ferramentas como Scanntech, Salesforce, Nielsen e MTRIX.

Diferenciais

  • Ter atuado com redes varejistas estratégicas ou canais estruturados de distribuição será considerado um diferencial competitivo.
  • Perfil analítico e estratégico, com forte orientação para resultados.
  • Capacidade de liderança, gestão de equipes e desenvolvimento de parceiros comerciais.
  • Proatividade, dinamismo e habilidade para atuar em ambientes desafiadores e com múltiplas demandas.
  • Alta capacidade de organização e visão de negócio.
  • Comprometimento com a execução da estratégia comercial e os direcionamentos da companhia.

Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Universidade Corporativa
  • Plano de Carreira
  • Day off no mês do Aniversário
  • Descontos nos produtos Catupiry em nosso Empório

Você sonha em trabalhar na Catupiry? Então a hora é agora!

Somos o primeiro requeijão cremoso do Brasil! Só Catupiry é Catupiry! Uma receita de família que faz sucesso há mais de 100 anos fez com que nos tornássemos uma empresa de alimentos. São tantos produtos gostosos que fica difícil escolher, não é mesmo? Desde o café da manhã, almoço ou jantar e até mesmo àquela ocasião especial, que só Catupiry é capaz de transformar.

Estar presente na vida de diversas gerações sendo sinônimo de qualidade com sabores únicos, com recheios, coberturas, pratos e até mesmo como ingrediente indispensável de inúmeros cardápios da gastronomia brasileira, é o que nos alimenta. E não paramos por aí... Nossa essência empreendedora é o que nos move, seguimos com um olhar para o futuro , sempre com o compromisso de entregar excelência e qualidade em todos os nossos produtos.

Venha fazer parte de um time que é apaixonado pelo que faz!

Todos os dias somos desafiados e motivados a fazer sempre o melhor. Estamos em constante evolução e inovação.

Convidamos você a viver esta experiência!
